caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical stone building with three floors, a central entrance with a staircase, and a cupola on the roof. The building is light gray in color, and the windows feature dark panes. The entrance is framed by an arched structure, and the building is enclosed by a black metal fence with stone pillars on each side of the gate. In front of the building, a wide stone path, composed of rectangular light brown and beige slabs, leads from the foreground directly to the entrance. The building and path are flanked by large deciduous trees with brown trunks and green and yellow foliage, with sunlight creating dappled shadows on the ground and parts of the building. Blue flowers and green shrubbery are visible near the base of the fence. The sky is light blue with white clouds, visible through the openings in the trees' foliage that frames the upper half of the image. The grass on either side of the path is green, with darker and lighter tones indicating sunlight and shadow.
title: New York City Hospital
